sources.name: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.verified_facts: January 2026 snapshot; 24.9 million residential premises with full fibre; 89% gigabit-capable; fixed/FWA decent-broadband gap 39,000 premises
sources.limitations: Aggregate and postcode evidence is not exact project-parcel identity or live provider orderability

sources.name: About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)
sources.verified_facts: 52 fixed and 18 FWA providers; AddressBase Epoch 123; CW and MK duplicate-file corrections; 121 all-premises postcode files renamed r2; documented 1,741,096 rows
sources.limitations: Documentation does not substitute for extracted ZIP inventory, SHA-256 or physical CSV row counts

sources.name: Fixed broadband coverage and full-fibre take-up archive
sources.publication_or_update: Official Spring 2026 download link; checked 29 July 2026
sources.verified_facts: Official link resolves as a 32.2 MB ZIP and reports application/x-zip-compressed
sources.limitations: Browser refuses binary content; container downloader failed; local shell has no external DNS, so bytes and hash remain unavailable

sources.name: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
sources.verified_facts: Premises-level regional ZIPs for nine English regions and Wales plus a public sample CSV; current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions
sources.limitations: Regional archives are large; exact project parcel binding still requires a trusted parcel-to-UPRN key

sources.name: UPRN level release user guide and technical note
sources.verified_facts: 28-field UPRN schema; current_gigabit and future_gigabit semantics; AddressBase premise base; contract overlap, supplier gaps and source-date limitations
sources.limitations: Recent delivery may lag and BDUK differs from Ofcom in premise base, suppliers and evaluation method

sources.name: OMR and BDUK plans sample CSV
sources.verified_facts: Official preview exposes 28 headers and 900 data rows, from preview line 84 through line 983; selected rows include current-only, future-only, current-and-future, GIS and voucher combinations
sources.limitations: Sample rows are not project parcels and cannot be loaded as business rows; raw CSV bytes and file hash were not retrieved

sources.name: Closure of the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.verified_facts: Evaluation remains underway; overall postcode and UPRN outputs will be published after assessment; next NR OMR is due September 2026
sources.limitations: No final May 2026 UPRN output rows are currently available on the outcome page

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.verified_facts: UPRN coordinates for approximately 40 million addressable locations; CSV and GeoPackage; includes non-postal addressable features
sources.limitations: A UPRN point is not necessarily one-to-one with a cadastral or project parcel

sources.name: OS Open UPRN product supply documentation
sources.verified_facts: Whole Great Britain supplied as one CSV or GeoPackage; CSV includes headers and one record per line; full supply only; refreshed with AddressBase epochs
sources.limitations: Specification describes supply but no product bytes were downloaded in this environment

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers
sources.verified_facts: Authoritative UPRN, USRN and TOID relationship lookup; CSV download
sources.limitations: Identifier relationships do not prove project parcel ownership or internet service availability

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers product structure
sources.verified_facts: Eleven relationship ZIP packages; each package includes CSV, version JSON, licence and description; BLPU_UPRN_TopographicArea_TOID_5 is the building-area relationship candidate
sources.limitations: Relationship files are large lookup tables without spatial geometry and were not downloaded

sources.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
sources.verified_facts: Freehold registered-property subset; one file per local authority; unique INSPIRE ID per polygon; title can have multiple polygons; monthly publication
sources.limitations: Indicative extent only; leaseholds and other tenures absent; cross-boundary polygons duplicated; not legal title extent

sources.name: INSPIRE local-authority GML download index
sources.verified_facts: Current GML downloads are listed by local authority and replaced on the first Sunday of each month
sources.limitations: Redirect loop prevented direct GML link extraction and byte download in this environment

sources.name: Technical guidance for GML files
sources.verified_facts: British National Grid source CRS; reprojection to web mapping may shift some features by up to 15 metres
sources.limitations: A fixed 15 m warning is a maximum risk statement, not a licence to accept every near match

sources.name: Gigabit capable broadband local indicator
sources.verified_facts: Lower-tier and unitary-authority percentage indicator for January 2026, sourced from Ofcom; CSV, CSVW and XLSX export offered
sources.limitations: Aggregated indicator may differ from original figures and has no parcel-level identity or confidence intervals
